nodes.summary: For a rational number $r$ and a natural number $k$, the generalized binomial coefficient is the rational number $\binom{r}{k} = r(r-1)\cdots(r-k+1)/k!$, which is $1$ for $k = 0$.
nodes.title: Binomial coefficient with rational upper argument

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $p$ and $q$ with $p > 1$ and $0 < q < p$, the $(p,q)$-Patalan number with index $n \in \mathbb{N}$ is the rational number $b(n) = -p^{2n+1} \binom{n - q/p}{n+1}$, where $\binom{r}{k} = r(r-1)\cdots(r-k+1)/k!$ is the binomial coefficient with rational upper argument $r$.
nodes.title: The (p,q)-Patalan numbers

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $p$ and $q$ with $p > 1$ and $0 < q < p$, and natural numbers $i$ and $j$, the $(p,q)$-super Patalan number is the rational number $Q(i,j) = (-1)^j p^{2(i+j)} \binom{i - q/p}{i+j}$, where $\binom{r}{k} = r(r-1)\cdots(r-k+1)/k!$ is the binomial coefficient with rational upper argument $r$.
nodes.title: The (p,q)-super Patalan numbers

nodes.summary: An admissible parameter pair for the $(p,q)$-Patalan numbers is a pair of natural numbers $p$ and $q$ with $p > 1$ and $0 < q < p$.
nodes.title: Admissible parameters for the (p,q)-Patalan numbers

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p > 1$ and natural numbers $i$ and $j$, the super Patalan number of order $p$ is the $(p,q)$-super Patalan number with $q = 1$, that is, the rational number $(-1)^j p^{2(i+j)} \binom{i - 1/p}{i+j}$, where $\binom{r}{k} = r(r-1)\cdots(r-k+1)/k!$ is the binomial coefficient with rational upper argument $r$.
nodes.title: Super Patalan numbers of order p

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
